blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Fullerton
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: CSUF commencement week brings thousands of families to campus parking that is limited and metered, making chauffeured drop and pickup a genuinely useful product.
Angel Stadium and Honda Center are a short drive but their parking sells out, so a group with a driver walks straight in.
Downtown Fullerton and the Fox Theatre are pedestrian-scale with almost no event parking on Orange Avenue.
The I-5, SR 57 and SR 91 convergence means guests bounce between venues and hotels with no short route.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Fullerton Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.

blocks.text: Licensed, Insured, and Backup Plans

Every chauffeur on our team is licensed and background checked, and our vehicles are licensed and inspected. Our drivers work the night and do not drink, which matters when the group includes teenagers, and we set a fixed return time off the venue's posted close so nobody is standing in a parking lot at 1 AM wondering where the car went.

Send us four things and we will put a fixed number in writing: your date and start time, how many passengers and how many are under 18, your pickup address or ZIP, and how many stops. Most Fullerton groups find a four-hour minimum covers the night comfortably.
